title: 09. The Forgetful Goblin
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Hori had been drawing happily. But when it was time to tidy up, something was missing. Where's my yellow crayon? It had been right here. Hori tilted his head. Where did it go?
Hori looked under the desk, searched his backpack, and opened his cubby. Still no yellow crayon. I've lost it again. His shoulders drooped.
Teacher Sheep invited Hori to sit on a lap. Hori, would you like to hear a story from long ago? The friends gathered close. What story? It's about the Forgetful Goblin.

Long ago, a forgetful goblin lived deep in the mountains. The goblin left everything wherever it happened to land. The magic club here, the hat there. In the story, the goblin tossed the club down carelessly.
But one day, the goblin's magic club disappeared. Huh? Where's my club? The goblin's eyes grew wide.
Without the club, the goblin couldn't do magic. The goblin searched all over the mountains. What if I can't find it? I'm in trouble! The goblin grew more and more worried.

After a long search, the goblin found the club under the wooden platform where breakfast had been eaten. Here it is! The goblin hugged it tightly. From now on, I'll give it a proper place and take care of it.
When the story ended, Hori's eyes grew round. The Forgetful Goblin is just like me! I leave my things anywhere, too. Suddenly, Hori understood.

Hori jumped up and chose a place for each thing. Crayons in the crayon box. Backpack in the cubby. Then something shone under the chair. Found it! My yellow crayon! He must have dropped it there earlier.

Now Hori put everything back in its place after playing. Back in place, and no more forgetting! His tail stripes sparkled like a rainbow. Both Hori and the Forgetful Goblin felt better when their things had a proper place.
